messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] GPU nodepool queue growth detected — overall GPU task queue > 1100 and rising, sustained 5m > threshold. autoscaler error rate high. Paging on-call (jess). Alert: https://redwood.internal/alerts/INC-2781234567 :rotating_light:

jess (oncall): on it. can folks post the autoscaler logs + recent ASG events? tagging infra.

samir (infra): sharing the cluster-autoscaler pod logs; looks like repeated failures on instance creation with AttachRole/LaunchTemplate errors. snippet:```time="2026-03-15T02:12:34Z" level=error msg="Error creating instance: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/k8s-autoscaler is not authorized to perform: ec2:RunInstances on resource: arn:aws:ec2:..."```

samir (infra): also seeing this in nodegroup controller:```E0315 02:13:01.123456    1234 provider_aws.go:456] Failed to create instance: launch template version mismatch: required tag missing: 'k8s:gpu=true'```

devon (sre): confirmed autoscaler tried 24x in last 10m, backoff increasing. cluster-autoscaler status:```ScaleUp: failed to provision 4 nodes, last error: insufficient permissions to attach instance profile | launchTemplate validation failed (taints/labels mismatch)```

jess (oncall): customers impacted? any 5xxs or timeouts surfaced? maria?

maria (product): ingest metrics show request latency for GPU-backed endpoints spiking, ~18% of requests falling back to queue >30s, ~3% hitting client timeouts. key affected svc: inference-gpu-prod and batch-renderer. tracking list: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2781234567/impact

jess (oncall): thanks. quick mitigations idea thread: 1) try manual scale-up of ASG with correct launch template version 2) remove the problematic taint to allow CPU-only fallback pools to pick up some pods 3) temporarily route non-low-latency jobs to dedicated pool or reduce model size. which is fastest?

samir (infra): fastest is manual ASG bump but beware AttachRole still blocks if instance profile attach fails. I'll attempt to create a transient instance with same LT to validate. running:```aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-asg --desired-capacity 6 --honor-cooldown```

ops-bot: Manual ASG request acknowledged. ticket #ASG-78123 created.

samir (infra): OK created 1 test instance via aws cli using LT v3, it booted but kubelet failed to join due to taint mismatch: node registered as "gpu=false" because AMI missing NVIDIA drivers. log from instance:```/var/log/cloud-init.log: install-nvidia: failed to fetch driver tarball: AccessDenied to S3 bucket s3://redwood-gpu-drivers-prod```

devon (sre): so two failure modes: IAM/AttachRole and driver S3 permission on AMI userdata. both need fixes. short-term: we can remove pod anti-affinity + taint on a couple of CPU nodes and let some GPU-sched pods land (will be slower) or fall back to CPU model.

jess (oncall): can we taint remove for specific deployments only? I prefer scoped changes rather than cluster-wide.

samir (infra): can do per-deployment tolerations change but requires a rollout. quicker: add toleration to the deployment temporarily:```kubectl -n inference patch deploy inference-gpu --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/tolerations/-","value":{"key":"gpu","operator":"Exists","effect":"NoSchedule"}}]'
```

maria (product): do that for non-SLA paths only. don't change core low-latency routes. I'll give you a list: inference-gpu-batch, render-precompute.

jess (oncall): go for it. samir, devon, coordinate. I'll page infra escalation if ASG/LaunchTemplate permission issue needs AWS account-side change.

samir (infra): FYI AWS account team responded: role k8s-autoscaler lacks iam:PassRole for instance profile the LT references. Suggest patching role policy. I'll open PR to attach minimal PassRole and ec2:RunInstances permissions. Ticket: IAM-1245. ETA ~30m for PR + deploy.

devon (sre): in parallel, I'm going to add tolerations to the two batch deployments listed by maria so they can be scheduled onto CPU nodes. Executing now.

devon (sre): patched batch deployments. verifying pods are rescheduled... good, some pods are starting on CPU nodes (slower). queue drain rate improved marginally.

maria (product): initial customer-facing note: "We're experiencing degraded throughput for GPU-backed workflows; working on infrastructure fixes. Some jobs may be slower than usual. Expect updates in 30 min." I'll send to customers on affected SLAs in 10m.

ops-bot: Runbook step executed: temporarily increased CPU fallback by adding tolerations to two deployments.

samir (infra): PR for IAM in flight, deploying in staging first. Patch includes:```- iam:PassRole on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/k8s-gpu-instance-profile - ec2:RunInstances - ec2:CreateTags```

pagerduty-bot: on-call escalation: jess acknowledged. escalate to senior infra after 20m if not resolved.

jess (oncall): update: IAM PR merged and applied. autoscaler now able to call RunInstances but new nodes still failing to join because userdata cannot fetch driver tarball (S3 AccessDenied). copying policy fix to S3 team.

samir (infra): S3 policy change applied (grant read to role used by LT userdata). launching 3 nodes.

ops-bot: launched 3 nodes via ASG desired-capacity bump.

devon (sre): nodes booted and successfully joined cluster, labelled gpu=true, taints applied. kube-scheduler now placing pending pods. queue drain rate back to normal.

maria (product): metrics: latency and queue length trending down, timeouts falling to baseline. customer notice updated: "Mitigation in place; queue and throughput improving, will monitor."

jess (oncall): great. I'm going to hand this to L2 for postmortem and remediation tasks — root cause: combined policy gap (iam:PassRole) + missing S3 read perms on AMI userdata + launch template version tag mismatch that hid the issue during autoscaler rollout.

jess (oncall): Handoff to rachel for postmortem/cleanup. rachel, pls pick up the follow-ups: 1) ensure LT tag/versioning guard 2) expand e2e for ASG boot+join 3) narrow IAM policies so not overly permissive 4) add synthetic monitor for driver fetch success. playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-autoscale-boot-fail

rachel (oncall-next): acked. will take it. adding tasks to infra backlog and scheduling postmortem meeting.

jess (oncall): closing pager status: mitigated. will leave incident open until postmortem. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
